text:
Sammy Cho: hey team! just wrapped onboarding — hi :wave: i'm sammy (they/them). i skateboard to the office and was wondering where folks usually leave boards during the day? also, where are the best bagel spots nearby? :skateboard: :baguette_bread:
Mira Sato: welcome sammy!! :confetti_ball: people often use the rack by the courtyard stairs, but some tuck boards under the standing lockers on 3. bring a lock if you can.
People Ops: @Sammy Cho welcome aboard! your badge is active. desk assigned: 3B-17. DM if you need any extra gear.
Sammy Cho: thanks — can you confirm the swag pickup window?
Onboard Bot: hi @Sammy Cho — swag pickup scheduled today at 4:30pm by reception. bring your badge.
Alex Jensen: hey sammy, lunch crew leaves ~12:15. today's rotation is the ramen/bento run. wanna join?
Sammy Cho: ramen yes please :ramen: count me in.
Talia Bhat: welcome! rooftop coffee meetup at 10 tomorrow if you want a mellow intro. also curious what board you ride — pics? :camera_with_flash:
Sammy Cho: will post a grainy action shot. it's an old Powell-Peralta cruiser with worn grip.
Noel Gomez: fun fact: someone once labeled a board "property of ops" and it mysteriously ended up being court's permanent office prop. watch out for the office goose too :duck: :joy:
Mira Sato: haha. pro tip: keep a helmet in your locker; peg hooks near 3B are handy.
Sammy Cho: quick ops q — where's the snack/coffee preference form?
People Ops: here's the short form: https://intranet.redwood/ops/snack-preferences — fill it out and we'll note allergies/preferences.
Alex Jensen: pro suggestion: mark "extra hot" for coffee if you like it that way.
Sammy Cho: form submitted. also, who do i bug for a second monitor?
People Ops: we'll coordinate monitors this week. DM if you need one urgently and we'll prioritize.
Mira Sato: see you at swag pickup and rooftop if you make it. welcome again! :wave: :thumbsup:
